source_statement: For arbitrary real fixed-D matrix kernels and explicit left/right boundary vectors, each positive-length ordered word has the exact coefficient of the scalar-boundary dependent chain obtained by right-terminal and first-core left absorption. Its actual bonds are bounded by max(D,1); its local scalar-address count is at most2*N*max(D,1)^2. All shapes including D=0 and N=1 are included; no normalization, circuit or runtime conclusion.
